_about: Which harness test file runs where: "pr" = the safety-critical set every harness PR runs (privacy scrub, records publish and fetch, discovery pick and judge, journey check, gates, ledgers, owner guards); "daily" = everything else, run by harness-daily.yml. Every file in test/ is in exactly one list (test/test-sets.test.mjs). "folderReaders" names tests in test/ that read every module in a harness folder, including consumers of the SUITES registry; "./" covers only files directly in desktop/e2e/. "folderReaderExceptions" records why a discovery candidate is not a folder reader.

folderReaderExceptions.a11y.test.mjs: Uses triage, which enumerates artifact directories and refers to suite paths without reading the suites folder.
folderReaderExceptions.ai-answers-engine.test.mjs: Imports no-real-ai.mjs directly (its checkAiMisses lists a temporary ai-misses folder; this test never calls it); the only directories it lists are temporary answer tables, not harness code.
